jobs.title: FP&A Analyst II
jobs.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

Why is this FP&A Analyst II role different
This role offers the opportunity to be a key contributor within a growing DME organization, partnering directly with business leaders to drive financial planning and decision-making. You'll own critical components of forecasting, reporting, and expense management processes while gaining exposure to senior leadership. This position is ideal for a finance professional who enjoys transforming complex data into actionable insights and influencing business outcomes through meaningful analysis.

In addition, this team primarily supports stakeholders operating in the Pacific Time Zone (PST). Success in this role requires a candidate who is comfortable aligning their workday and collaborating within PST business hours to support reporting deadlines, meetings, and business partnerships.

Key Highlights
- Team primarily operates within the Pacific Time Zone (PST)
- Supporting a growing healthcare and DME organization
- High-visibility role with exposure to senior leadership
- Own portions of forecasting, reporting, and expense management processes
- Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the business
- Opportunity to improve processes and influence strategic decision-making
- Mix of financial analysis, business partnership, and operational support
- Significant exposure to leaders across multiple business functions

Salary Range
- $80,000 – $85,000 annually. Compensation offered may vary based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and location

What You'll Do
- Support FP&A activities, including forecasting, reporting, and expense management.
- Conduct financial analysis, forecasting, and modeling to provide actionable business insights.
- Build and maintain financial models to support strategic decision-making and scenario planning.
- Prepare and deliver monthly financial reports, including variance analysis and commentary.
- Assist with month-end and quarter-end close activities in partnership with cross-functional teams.
- Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
- Perform expense reconciliations and investigate significant variances.
- Extract, manipulate, and analyze financial and operational data from multiple sources.
- Create recurring and ad hoc reports to support leadership decision-making.
- Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and reporting enhancements.
- Partner with operational leaders to understand business performance and key drivers.
- Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to stakeholders.

What We Look For
- Comfortable working with a team that primarily operates in the Pacific Time Zone (PST).
- Strong intellectual curiosity and proactive problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrated analytical and financial acumen.
- Strong business partnership and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Ability to translate complex financial information into actionable insights.
- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on efficiency and scalability.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
- Ability and willingness to align work schedules with PST business hours to support business needs.
- Professional, collaborative, and customer-focused approach.

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required

Experience
- 2–3 years of experience in FP&A, Finance, Accounting, or a related analytical role.
- Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting activities preferred.
- Healthcare or DME industry experience is a plus.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional business partners preferred.

Computer Skills
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, complex formulas, pivot tables, scenario analysis, data manipulation.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint.
- Experience with financial planning or business intelligence tools (TM1, Hyperion, Power BI, etc.) preferred.
- Ability to work with large datasets and multiple reporting systems

Financial & Analytical Skills
- Advanced financial modeling and forecasting capabilities.
- Strong understanding of income statements, P&L management, variance analysis, key business performance drivers.
- Ability to analyze large datasets and identify trends, risks, and opportunities
- Strong quantitative, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
- Experience developing business cases and scenario analysis to support decision-making.
- Ability to convert complex financial information into business recommendations.

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.
Teammate Benefits
As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

Our benefits program includes:

- Short-and long-term disability coverage
- Accident insurance

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Director, Procurement Excellence & Transformation
jobs.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

Position Summary
The Director, Procurement Excellence & Transformation is a senior procurement leader responsible for advancing the effectiveness, governance, capabilities, and maturity of the procurement function. Working closely with the Chief Procurement Officer (CPO) and senior business leaders, this role leads procurement transformation, process optimization, digital enablement, analytics, capability development, supplier risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives across the enterprise.

The Director develops and executes a multi-year Procurement Excellence and Transformation roadmap in support of the enterprise procurement strategy, helping drive organizational growth, financial performance, operational resilience, compliance, and supply continuity. This role is accountable for establishing and continuously improving procurement methodologies, governance frameworks, technologies, and performance management practices that enhance operational effectiveness, support category management excellence, and advance procurement maturity.

In a healthcare products and services environment, the Director helps ensure procurement processes, capabilities, supplier risk programs, and technology investments support product availability, regulatory compliance, business continuity, and long-term organizational success.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $140k - $200k annual. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Procurement Excellence

·       Develop and execute a multi-year Procurement Excellence and Transformation roadmap in support of the enterprise procurement strategy, enabling cost optimization, risk mitigation, organizational effectiveness, digital enablement, and operational excellence.
·       Responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving methodologies, governance frameworks, standards, tools, and leading practices that enable procurement performance and consistency across the organization.
·       Partner with the CPO to implement and continuously improve the Procurement operating model, governance structures, service delivery frameworks, organizational capabilities, decision rights, and procurement maturity objectives.
·       Translate procurement strategic priorities into executable programs, governance models, and capability-building initiatives.
·       Assess procurement performance against industry benchmarks and leading practices and develop capability roadmaps that advance procurement maturity.
·       Lead the development of annual functional priorities aligned with enterprise and procurement objectives.
·       Enable Direct and Indirect Procurement teams through standardized methodologies, tools, training, analytics, governance, technology solutions, and best practices that improve organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.

Procurement Transformation & Change Leadership
·       Lead the design, prioritization, and execution of enterprise procurement transformation initiatives aligned with business strategy and procurement maturity objectives.
·       Build and manage a multi-year procurement transformation portfolio that includes technology modernization, process redesign, capability-building initiatives, operating model enhancements, and organizational effectiveness programs approved through procurement leadership governance.
·       Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, digitize, and scale procurement processes and ways of working.
·       Develop transformation business cases, implementation roadmaps, success metrics, and value realization plans.
·       Partner with executive stakeholders to secure alignment, investment, resources, and sponsorship for transformational initiatives.
·       Establish and lead change management strategies that drive stakeholder engagement, adoption, capability development, and sustained outcomes.
·       Monitor emerging market trends, digital innovations, AI capabilities, and procurement best practices to evolve organizational capabilities and maintain a best-in-class procurement function.
·       Lead complex cross-functional initiatives that improve procurement effectiveness, stakeholder experience, productivity, compliance, and business performance.

Procurement Governance & Operating Excellence
·       Develop, maintain, and administer procurement policies, standards, procedures, controls, and compliance frameworks.
·       Develop and maintain procurement playbooks, sourcing methodologies, toolkits, governance processes, templates, and standard operating procedures.
·       Define and maintain procurement decision-making frameworks, approval authority matrices, escalation pathways, and RACI models.
·       Ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability across procurement processes and sourcing activities.
·       Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to strengthen governance, controls, and policy adherence.
·       Drive enterprise-wide adoption of standardized procurement processes and best practices.

Process, Systems & Digital Procurement
·       Own and continuously improve Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes and supporting workflows.
·       Drive standardization and optimization across source-to-contract, category management, supplier management, contracting, and procure-to-pay processes.
·       Lead digital procurement transformation initiatives, including eSourcing, contract lifecycle management, supplier relationship management, spend analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled procurement capabilities.
·       Identify opportunities to leverage automation, predictive analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies to improve user experience, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
·       Partner with Information Technology teams to establish procurement technology roadmaps and system enhancement priorities.
·       Ensure successful adoption, utilization, and governance of procurement technologies and digital tools.

Procurement Analytics, Insights & Performance Management
·       Establish enterprise procurement reporting, analytics, dashboards, and performance measurement frameworks.
·       Develop standardized methodologies for measuring spend under management, savings, cost avoidance, value creation, supplier performance, risk, compliance, working capital impact, and productivity.
·       Deliver actionable insights that support executive decision-making, category strategies, and business planning.
·       Lead procurement performance management reviews and drive accountability for results.
·       Promote data-driven decision-making and analytical rigor throughout the procurement organization.
·       Develop executive-level reporting that communicates procurement impact, transformation progress, risks, and opportunities.

Category Management Excellence & Value Realization
·       Develop and maintain enterprise category management methodologies, sourcing frameworks, governance standards, templates, and best practices.
·       Partner with Direct and Indirect Procurement leaders to strengthen category strategy development, sourcing execution, supplier management, and procurement discipline.
·       Ensure consistent application of category management principles and strategic sourcing methodologies across procurement teams.
·       Establish standards for sourcing project management, opportunity assessment, business case development, benefits tracking, and value measurement.
·       Lead governance processes supporting value realization, procurement performance measurement, and enterprise reporting.
·       Partner with Finance to validate savings, cost avoidance, working capital improvements, and broader value creation initiatives.
·       Identify opportunities to improve spend visibility, sourcing effectiveness, supplier leverage, and value delivery.
·       Maintain enterprise category management standards and governance while enabling Category Directors and Category Managers to execute sourcing and supplier strategies aligned with business objectives.

Supplier Risk Management & Resilience
·       Develop, administer, and continuously improve supplier risk management methodologies, tools, reporting standards, and governance processes.
·       Collaborate with procurement, supply chain, quality, compliance, and business leaders to strengthen supplier resiliency and business continuity capabilities.
·       Establish supplier risk monitoring and reporting processes that support proactive risk identification and mitigation.
·       Support responsible sourcing, supplier diversity, sustainability, and ESG-related procurement initiatives.

Executive Partnership & Organizational Influence
·       Serve as a strategic advisor to the CPO and senior leadership team on procurement effectiveness, transformation priorities, organizational capabilities, and performance improvement opportunities.
·       Facilitate procurement governance forums, executive steering committees, and cross-functional decision-making processes by providing performance insights, recommendations, and program updates.
·       Present procurement performance, transformation progress, value realization, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
·       Build trusted relationships with leaders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Information Technology, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Quality, and other key business functions.
·       Influence stakeholders to drive alignment, adoption, and sustained organizational change.
·       Represent procurement in enterprise initiatives and strategic planning activities.

What Success Looks Like
·       Direct and Indirect Procurement teams are enabled through effective governance, analytics, processes, technology, training, and operating standards that improve procurement performance and organizational capability.
·       Procurement is recognized as a high-performing strategic business partner and center of excellence.
·       Procurement maturity advances measurably against internal and external benchmarks.
·       Transformation initiatives achieve targeted business outcomes and adoption objectives.
·       Standardized processes, governance frameworks, and operating models are successfully implemented and sustained.
·       Procurement technology investments deliver measurable improvements in user experience, productivity, analytics, visibility, compliance, and decision-making.
·       Procurement processes become increasingly automated, digital, scalable, and data-driven.
·       Category teams consistently utilize best-practice category management and sourcing methodologies.
·       Savings, value creation, supplier performance, compliance, and risk metrics are measured consistently and transparently.
·       Supplier risk management programs proactively identify and mitigate business continuity threats.
·       Procurement talent pipelines, capabilities, and succession plans support long-term organizational success.
·       Business stakeholders view procurement as an innovative partner and catalyst for change.

Demonstrated Leadership Competencies
·       Strategic Mindset
·       Business Insight
·       Drives Vision and Purpose
·       Decision Quality
·       Plans and Aligns
·       Organizational Savvy
·       Manages Complexity
·       Collaborates
·       Persuades
·       Communicates Effectively
·       Instills Trust
·       Develops Talent
·       Optimizes Work Processes
·       Drives Results
·       Ensures Accountability
·       Resourcefulness

Qualifications

·       Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Operations, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field required.
·       Master's degree (MBA, MS Supply Chain, Operations, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline) preferred.
·       10+ years of progressive experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, procurement operations, category management, procurement transformation, or operational excellence.
·       5+ years of leadership experience managing procurement functions, centers of excellence, transformation initiatives, procurement operations, or enterprise process improvement teams.
·       Demonstrated success leading procurement transformation, organizational effectiveness, digital procurement, operating model redesign, or enterprise procurement initiatives.
·       Strong expertise in category management, procurement governance, process improvement, supplier management, procurement analytics, change management, and procure-to-pay operations.
·       Experience implementing and optimizing procurement technologies, eProcurement platforms, spend analytics tools, contract lifecycle management systems, supplier management platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
·       Proven ability to lead large-scale cross-functional transformation programs and influence executive stakeholders.
·       Strong analytical, financial, communication, project management, and organizational leadership capabilities.
·       Experience within healthcare, healthcare products, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, distribution, or similarly regulated industries preferred.
·       Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, CPM, CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, PMP, or equivalent certifications are preferred.

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

Our benefits program includes:

The Director, Direct Procurement & Category Management is responsible for developing and executing enterprise-wide sourcing and category strategies for direct materials, components, raw materials, contract manufacturing, finished goods, packaging, and other production-related spend categories that directly impact product availability, quality, patient outcomes, and organizational profitability.

jobs.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $120,000 - $165,000 annual. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.

JOB SUMMARY
The General Manager (GM) is responsible for supporting sales efforts and will visit with HVT-high value customers and administration and efficient daily operation of the branch office, including operations, supporting sales through service levels, service, and safety in accordance with Apria’s objectives. This role has full P&L responsibility for their profit centers, including both revenue and operating income. In addition, the GM will communicate Apria values, strategies, and objectives, while assigning accountabilities, planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
- Full P&L responsibility for profit center(s) including both revenue and operating income.
- Collaborates with senior management to develop, review, update and implement business strategic planning, including sales and financial performance.
- Responsible for executing sales strategy and growth initiatives by personally building and maintaining relationships with key customers, helping sales team develop impactful territory plans and strategies, and assisting the sales staff to achieve results.
- Responsible for achieving key focus product starts budget and for cash collections.
- Utilizes technology and tools to their fullest capabilities in order to support and drive sales growth through exceptional service levels and optimize performance at the branch.
- Monitors staffing levels, expenditures, asset equipment utilization and inventory levels to ensure maximum profit margins.
- Ensures the effective operation and management of all functional areas of the branch such as customer service, collections, clinical, distribution, and supporting sales.
- Responsible for partnering with Managed Care counterpart to understand provider networks and grow market share.
- Monitors key performance indicators and is responsible for implementing corrective measures.
- Ensures operational procedures comply with federal, state, local and Joint Commission requirements.
- Responsible for providing a safe and healthful work environment and preventing injuries by leading and implementing the Safety & Risk Management program for the branch.
- Performs other duties as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Responsible for hiring, coaching, developing, and performance management of subordinate staff.
- Responsible for retention of sales and branch personnel through on-boarding, coaching, mentoring, and development.
